chapters.label: Derby day
chapters.text: North London derby, September 2024: Tottenham in white, Arsenal in black. Still no goals after sixty-four minutes. Bukayo Saka curls in a corner... Gabriel attacks it... Goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Gabriel waits behind Cristian Romero. The keeper, Vicario, is boxed in. Gabriel moves late, jumps, and powers it home.

chapters.label: From the corner
chapters.text: From behind Saka: the ball curls toward goal. Romero loses track of Gabriel, and Gabriel rises highest to head it in!

chapters.label: Attack the ball
chapters.text: Never stand still on the spot. Start your run late, and attack the ball. Don't wait for it!
